description: Java class 'EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator' extending an abstract actor for cleaning up event snapshots and reporting status, using Akka streams and actors.

classes.name: EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator
classes.description: Actor class managing cleanup of event snapshots and reporting status, extending an abstract background actor with config and status reporting capabilities.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation with configuration, pubSubMediator, and shardRegions.

methods.name: preEnhanceStreamingBehavior
methods.description: Defines message handling for CreditDecision and CleanupPersistenceResponse messages.

methods.name: reportToSelf
methods.description: Creates a flow that sends each element to self for acknowledgment.

methods.name: getEntityIdWithRevisionSource
methods.description: Builds a source combining persistence IDs and credit decisions.

methods.name: creditSource
methods.description: Creates a source of credit decisions.

methods.name: persistenceIdSource
methods.description: Creates a source of entity IDs with revisions.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Builds the main source of cleanup requests, asking shard regions for cleanup commands.

methods.name: askShardRegionForCleanup
methods.description: Sends cleanup request to shard region and handles response.

methods.name: postEnhanceStatusReport
methods.description: Adds credit decisions and actions to status report JSON.

methods.name: renderCreditDecision
methods.description: Converts a credit decision pair to JSON.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Converts a cleanup response to JSON with status and message.

methods.name: getResponseMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string from cleanup response.

methods.name: getCleanupCommand
methods.description: Creates a cleanup command with current timestamp in headers.
